name: Pukka
ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned. The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy.
interaction: Points at a player, who becomes poisoned. On later nights the previously poisoned player dies and becomes healthy.
drunk_or_poisoned: A choice made while drunk or poisoned does not poison. If the Pukka is drunk or poisoned when the kill would happen, the previous target does not die then; it dies once the Pukka is sober and healthy again.

rulings.text: The Pukka acts on the first night (poison only).
Exorcist on the Pukka: the Pukka does not wake, so no new player is poisoned, but the previously poisoned player still dies.
Innkeeper protection on the previously poisoned player prevents the death and they become healthy.
If the poisoned player dies another way, the poison remains until their death ability has resolved.

test_scenarios.name: poison then kill
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Pukka, Bob Chambermaid, Carol Gossip, Dave Godfather, Eve Innkeeper
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Alice chooses Bob. Night 2: Alice chooses Carol.
test_scenarios.expected: Night 1 Bob is poisoned (may get false info). Night 2 Bob dies and Carol is poisoned.

test_scenarios.name: executed target
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Pukka, Bob Fool, Carol Gossip, Dave Godfather, Eve Innkeeper
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Alice chooses Bob. Day 1: Bob is executed. Night 2: Alice chooses Carol.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob dies on execution (poisoned Fool has no ability); Night 2 nobody dies and Carol is poisoned.

test_scenarios.name: Exorcist blocks
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Pukka, Bob Pacifist, Carol Exorcist, Dave Godfather, Eve Chef
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Alice chooses Bob. Night 2: Carol exorcises Alice.
test_scenarios.expected: Night 2 Alice does not wake: no new poisoning occurs, but Bob (poisoned, so the Pacifist ability does not apply) still dies.

test_scenarios.name: Innkeeper saves
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Pukka, Bob Chef, Carol Innkeeper, Dave Godfather, Eve Empath
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Alice chooses Bob. Night 2: Carol protects Bob; Alice chooses Eve.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob survives and becomes healthy; Eve is poisoned.

test_scenarios.name: drunk choice does nothing
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Pukka, Bob Chef, Carol Sailor, Dave Godfather, Eve Empath
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Alice is drunk (Sailor) and chooses Bob. Night 2: Alice chooses Eve.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob is never poisoned and does not die on Night 2; Eve is poisoned.
